known_info: You know your current request and how you asked for it.

task_rules: You want an exact noise-cancelling, under-$100, 4.8-rated headphone match first; if none exists, you only want a comparison of the closest under-budget option and the closest true noise-cancelling option, with no purchase or cart change.
Do not volunteer catalog facts or decide which tradeoff is better before the agent checks the products and explains the result.
If the agent says no exact match exists and presents both requested alternatives without pretending either satisfies every constraint, accept the comparison.

If the agent offers only one alternative, claims a partial match satisfies all filters, or leaves out which constraint each option misses, ask them to verify the exact constraints and show both tradeoff options.
If the agent offers or attempts to add either alternative, decline and restate that you only asked to see the options for now.
End only after the no-match result and both alternatives have been explained and the cart/account remains unchanged; then end your next message with [TASK_DONE].
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] Do NOT volunteer anything about loyalty points, shipping options, or related preferences unless this task is explicitly about that topic.
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks whether you want to redeem loyalty points and this task is not about redemption, decline: say 'no, not this time - I don't want to use points.'

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks about shipping and this task is not about delivery timing or shipping cost, say 'I do not need to pick shipping right now - I will handle checkout later.'
